question: does definition A (content-defined chunks + protection band + contiguous containment) select the right record when every read must return an actual top-1 output, and does that output ever fabricate bytes?

definition.chunking: gear hash, rolling = ((rolling << 1) + gear[byte]) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, gear deterministically derived from sha256('taiji-gear-v1' + byte); cut when (rolling & 0x3F) == 0 after at least 16 bytes, or at 128 bytes unconditionally. Chunk fingerprint = sha256(chunk)[:16].hex(). The cut test reads the low six bits, i.e. the last six bytes, so a prefix shifts every later boundary by exactly the prefix length and leaves chunk *contents* unchanged.
definition.identity: S(r) = ordered fingerprints of the chunks that do not overlap the first 16 or the last 16 bytes of r. Fewer than two remaining chunks -> the record has no identity and is rejected alone.
definition.anchor: A record is anchored iff S(r) occurs as a contiguous subsequence of C(Q), the ordered fingerprints of all query chunks (the query is not banded). Anchors are readings, not exits. No prefix, suffix, boilerplate or unrelated snippet can create an anchor: the whole interior must be present, in order, contiguously.
definition.output: Top-1 always. Rank by covered blocks descending, coverage ratio descending, address index ascending. The output is the selected record's stored bytes: the full record when its identity is contained, otherwise the byte span of the longest contiguous run; a zero-coverage query still returns the first record's full bytes. Provenance = address, span, coverage, identity length.
definition.write: Append-only, never a batch rollback, never an eviction, never a silent overwrite. A record is rejected alone when (a) fewer than two identity chunks remain, (b) an equal identity holds a different value, (c) its identity and an existing identity are contiguous subsequences of one another.

paraphrase.note: only these records produce a synonym variant; a middle edit breaks the contiguous containment, so they are expected to be unanswerable and stay in the denominator

queries.should_anchor: 58 self reads + 58 lead-in variants ('总的来说，' + text + '。') + 4 synonym variants = 120; every one is scored by L3 on the output
queries.should_unknown: 20 held-out paragraphs, never written; no correct record
queries.should_ambiguous: the union paragraph k || '\n\n' || k+30 for the frozen pairs, counted when both records were admitted
queries.unrelated: 20 paragraphs from files that are neither written nor paraphrased

rules: closed not neutral -> hard failure, stop
L3 correct >= 100/120 AND wrong <= 1 AND fabricated = 0 AND faithful >= 0.95 -> identity_A_output_holds
verdict.denominator_note: the four synonym rewrites cannot be answered by definition A; they are counted as wrong person, never removed

criteria.C1_closed_state_neutral: with sc_sfk_enabled=False the 176-case battery reproduces the stored baseline arrays bit for bit (max|delta| = 0), parameters / state bytes / candidate sha / store signature unchanged, and no table allocated.
criteria.C2_same_implementation: the table under test is the AddressTable allocated by LivingCoreConfig(sc_sfk_enabled=True) through attach_store; writes go through write_batch_checked, reads through table.read. Zero new parameters.
criteria.C3_no_tuning: no threshold is tuned, the corpus and denominators do not move, and the verdict is recomputed with the same frozen rules. Synonym rewrites stay in the denominator even though definition A cannot answer them.
criteria.L1_mechanical: fabricated bytes = bytes of the output that differ from the claimed record's slice; a span outside the record or a length mismatch is illegal. Target 0.
criteria.L2_content: output == claimed record's bytes[start:end], counted over every query.
criteria.L3_selection: claimed address == the record the query was written from (120).
criteria.errors: wrong person = faithful but wrong address; fabrication = not faithful; empty output = zero bytes.
criteria.V_output_fabricates: fabricated bytes > 0 -> representation layer, no address patch.
criteria.V_identity_A_output_holds: closed neutral AND L3 >= 100/120 AND wrong <= 1 AND fabricated = 0 AND faithful >= 0.95 -> identity_A_output_holds.
criteria.V_output_insufficient: L3 < 100 and fabricated = 0: report the distribution only.
